name: Outdoor metal folding chair
material: Teslin fabric + powder-coated metal frame, custom orders welcome.
description: Be ready for the warmer weather, with these reclining garden chairs. Steel frames are strong and supportive - they are foldable too, so you can carry and store them around easily. The back can be set to five different positions - lean back to an angle which suits. Fabric seats to hold your body, complete with a pillow for headneck comfort and support.
